methods_read: Paper PDF pages 8 and 9: Figure 8/9 captions, visually checked
Supplement PDF page 4: train variance analysis
Supplement PDF page 14: Figure S8, visually checked

measured_recovery_constant.scope: VM2 Figure S8D after pause in 7 Hz stimulation; not Figure S8B high-frequency-train recovery; evaluation observation, not candidate parameter

abbott_1997_reference.locations: Printed p223, notes6/7/10; PDF page5 visually checked
abbott_1997_reference.scope: Rat visual cortex reference; no Drosophila parameter transfer

stage_1_source_numerical_reproduction.model: One scalar efficacy per independent source synapse, with no brain graph
stage_1_source_numerical_reproduction.event_order: Emit amplitude a_pre, then assign a_post=f*a_pre
stage_1_source_numerical_reproduction.regular_rate_steady_state: A(r)=(1-exp(-1/(r*tau)))/(1-f*exp(-1/(r*tau))); r and tau in reciprocal units

optional_published_response_kernel.scope: Abbott source model only; normalized waveform, no pA or male voltage prediction

stage_1_source_numerical_reproduction.initial_state: a=1 after an explicitly fully recovered reset
numerical_checks: Float64 recurrence agrees with analytic regular-rate steady state after verified convergence
Interrupted train recovery agrees with closed form
Event amplitude is read before per-spike decrement
For 0<=f<=1 and initial 0<=a<=1 all states remain bounded
Missing events do not cause depression
Exact event times and no rounded 7 Hz period
explicitly_excluded: Fitting f or tau to female fly data
Importing Abbott parameters into fruitfly runtime
Adjusting existing contact weight or PN threshold

stage_2_fly_protocol_comparison.preparation_scope: Adult female 2-7 days; minimal antennal-nerve single-ORN input; somatic PN voltage clamp; VM2 for Figures8D-G,9B-D,S8A-D

amplitude_protocol.normalization: Each train amplitude divided by its first test-train response, consistent with Figure8F percent initial axis
amplitude_protocol.proposed_phase_convention_not_explicit_a: Baseline events -4+j/7 seconds for j=0..27; test events j/r from0 inclusive to.5 exclusive. Record this as a simulation convention and assess timing sensitivity; do not claim exact experimental pulse phase.
readouts: Response waveform with explicitly declared kernel
Amplitude normalized to first test event
Residual versus digitized mean and SEM

charge_protocol.all_charge_curve_frequencies: Digitize before running; all low-frequency positions are not labeled individually
charge_protocol.readout: Normalized integrated response, no absolute pA or charge in coulombs claim
unresolved_methods: Exact baseline subtraction for charge integral
Stimulus phase and sampling at window boundaries
Pulse-specific amplitude extraction when responses overlap

recovery_protocols.use: Temporal evaluation only, do not fix a parameter to this value and then claim a held-out prediction

stage_2_fly_protocol_comparison.stochastic_assay_boundary: Figure8G and supplement Eq6 compare inverse CV squared with mean amplitude, using 1/CV^2=N*p/(1-p). Deterministic efficacy alone cannot reproduce this. Need separately justified stochastic release and quantal observation model; anatomical contacts are not established N and 1-f is not established p.

evaluation.first_comparison: No fit. Use published reference f=.75,tau=.3s and report descriptive errors on the fly temporal curves; success is not assumed.
evaluation.disclosure: Figures already inspected to form this proposal. Reserved evaluation is a prospective model-fitting split, not unseen evidence. Multiple panels may share cells and normalization references; they are not independent biological replicates.
metrics: Normalized amplitude residuals at digitized pulse times
evaluation.no_biological_pass_threshold: Aggregate printed figures and SEM do not justify an independent trial likelihood or automatic biological acceptance threshold.
evaluation.fit_failure_action: Preserve mismatches. A new timescale/mechanism requires a separately specified model comparison and evidence; do not adjust the full-brain gain.

before_execution: Archive digitization inputs and outputs with source/page/coordinates/uncertainty
Resolve or explicitly fix every unspecified stimulus and analysis convention
Freeze model, initialization, extraction procedure, development/evaluation split, and comparison metrics
Retain sex, glomerulus and recording-compartment labels throughout
